circle.data-info: Pea under the brain. Anterior: GH, TSH, ACTH, FSH, LH, prolactin. Posterior: ADH + oxytocin (made in hypothalamus).
Tiny, mid-brain. Melatonin — sleep / day-night clock.
Neck, butterfly. Thyroxine speeds metabolism. Needs iodine. Over = thin + jittery; under = tired + goitre.
Four dots on the thyroid. PTH raises blood calcium (bone + kidney + gut).
Behind the sternum, big in children. Trains T-lymphocytes. Shrinks with age.
Hats on the kidneys. Cortex: cortisol, aldosterone. Medulla: adrenaline (fight-or-flight).
Islets of Langerhans. Insulin lowers blood glucose; glucagon raises it. Diabetes if insulin fails.
Ovary: oestrogen + progesterone. Testis: testosterone. Also make gametes (exocrine + endocrine in one organ).
